hook_stat.sub: Entries beaten to the 2026 James Dyson Award — a record field

Length of the infrared eye-tracking sideline test

diaspora_bullets: Co-inventor Radhika Saran grew up in Bengaluru and Mumbai
A screening tool, not a diagnosis — return-to-play calls stay with a healthcare professional
news_summary: Rumble Rims, a sideline concussion-screening headset built by Harvard students Cleo Pontone, Radhika Saran and Sophia DeVito, has won the Global Medical category of the 2026 James Dyson Award.
payoff: If validation holds up, an objective sideline check that today needs a clinic could become a $300 piece of kit in a coach's bag.
